stem.text: $1.0\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{PCl}_5\text{(g)}$, $1.0\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{PCl}_3\text{(g)}$ and $1.0\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{Cl}_2\text{(g)}$ are placed in a container of volume $1\,\text{dm}^{3}$ at $250\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ and allowed to reach equilibrium.
At this temperature, the equilibrium mixture contains $1.8\,\text{moles}$ of $\text{PCl}_3$.
What is the value of $K_\text{c}$ at $250\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$?
